answer: Grading load is capped by beacon-weighted sampling: a hash of the latest on-chain beacon decides which submissions receive full peer review, so a farm cannot predict which of its posts will be scrutinized. A sybil operator's trellis of near-identical answers must therefore all be genuine, since any one could be the lotus picked for deep inspection. The attacker pays by authoring every post as if it will be chosen, forfeiting the economy of templated mass production.
